verdicts.reason: A is chaotic. The logo is pushed to the far right and 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' is too small to read. The reserve-a-spot line is microscopic and floats in the middle. The subhead runs straight into the red legal box, the RSVP CTA is shrunk to pill size and lost among the tags, and the decorative circle is cropped at the left edge. B has a clearer left/centre/right structure: logo and details on the left, headline, date and pills in the centre, copy on the right. Its flaws are still serious. RSVP is buried as one more pill, 'FREEENTRY' is squeezed together, the legal box is jammed against TASTINGS, and the 'presents' label and the product art are tiny.
